meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 模型每次成功执行编辑类操作(如打补丁、写文件)后,comment-checker 会自动检查改动中的注释;发现被警告的注释时,会阻止流程,要求模型先修复或解释该注释。
howto.when: 当模型成功完成 apply_patch、write 等编辑类工具调用,且 comment-checker 对改动中的注释发出警告时触发。

say.text: 刚才的编辑触发 comment-checker 警告,请修复有问题的注释。
say.note: 模型会先处理被点名的注释再继续。

say.text: 警告似乎不对,请说明保留这条注释的理由。
say.note: 模型会给出解释来回应检查。

say.text: 有哪些注释被 comment-checker 点名了?
say.note: 模型会列出待处理的警告。

howto.what_en: After each successful edit operation (apply_patch, write, etc.), comment-checker automatically checks the changed comments. If it flags a problematic comment, it blocks progress and requires the model to fix or explain that comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: Triggered after a successful apply_patch, write, edit, multi_edit, or multiedit call when comment-checker emits a warning about a comment in the modified code.

say_en.text: The edit triggered a comment-checker warning; please fix the flagged comment.
say_en.note: The model will address that comment before continuing.

say_en.text: The warning may be wrong; explain why keeping this comment is valid.
say_en.note: The model will respond with a justification.
The model will list the warnings to handle.
